newsitem.title: ISRAEL: TENNIS-FIRST HARD COURT TITLE FOR SANCHEZ.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FIRST HARD COURT TITLE FOR SANCHEZ.

text.p: Javier Sanchez won the $328,000 Israel Open on Sunday with a straight sets victory over unseeded South African Marcos Ondruska.
The fourth-seeded Spaniard, ranked 46 in the world, needed one hour and 34 minutes to defeat the hard-hitting Ondruska 6-4 7-5 in a match played mostly from the baseline.
Sanchez earned $43,000 for his week's work. The win was his fourth career title but his first on a hard court.
